items.title: High-Yield Dividend Stocks Throw Off Serious Income. Where You Hold Them Matters
items.summary: Where you park a high-yield dividend stock can quietly cost you thousands in taxes every single year, and REITs and MLPs carry the steepest penalty of all for investors sitting in the wrong account.
